claim: CTC channel 3 polled with 32 T ticks can serve as a clock that places OUTs near their original T (model error about -24..+56 T).

evidence.text: CTC ch 3 polled with 32 T ticks places OUTs at the original T and 9907 at the original time; model OUT -24..+56 T, 9907 -25..+43 T.
evidence.quote: (CTC ch 3 polled, 32 T ticks), 9907 at the original time; model OUT -24..+56 T, 9907 -25..+43 T.
